headword: {文化週間|ぶんかしゅうかん}

definitions.explanation: A designated week celebrating culture and the arts. In Japan, the national Cultural Week runs from November 1 to 7, centered around Culture Day ({文化|ぶんか}の{日|ひ}) on November 3. Schools and communities also hold their own culture weeks with exhibitions, performances, and events.

examples.japanese: {文化週間|ぶんかしゅうかん}に{美術館|びじゅつかん}が{無料|むりょう}{開放|かいほう}される。
examples.english: Museums are opened free of charge during Culture Week.

examples.japanese: {学校|がっこう}の{文化週間|ぶんかしゅうかん}では、{各|かく}クラスが{展示|てんじ}や{発表|はっぴょう}を{行|おこな}う。
examples.english: During the school's culture week, each class puts on exhibitions and presentations.

examples.japanese: {文化週間|ぶんかしゅうかん}に{合|あ}わせて、{地域|ちいき}の{伝統|でんとう}{芸能|げいのう}を{紹介|しょうかい}するイベントが{開催|かいさい}された。
examples.english: An event introducing local traditional performing arts was held to coincide with Culture Week.

notes:
Composed of {文化|ぶんか} (culture) and {週間|しゅうかん} (week/awareness week). Japan's national {文化週間|ぶんかしゅうかん} falls on November 1-7, with November 3rd being {文化|ぶんか}の{日|ひ} (Culture Day), a national holiday. Many museums and cultural institutions offer free admission or special events during this period.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {文化週間|ぶんかしゅうかん}の{行事|ぎょうじ}: Culture Week events
- {文化週間|ぶんかしゅうかん}に{合|あ}わせて: to coincide with Culture Week
- {文化週間|ぶんかしゅうかん}の{一環|いっかん}として: as part of Culture Week

RELATED WORDS:
- {文化|ぶんか}の{日|ひ}: Culture Day — November 3rd national holiday
- {文化祭|ぶんかさい}: school culture festival — a related but distinct event
- {読書週間|どくしょしゅうかん}: Reading Week — another awareness week (Oct 27-Nov 9)
